risks.title: Economic and geopolitical conditions
risks.score_rationale: The company is sensitive to economic and geopolitical conditions, which directly impact freight volumes, demand for transportation services, and fuel costs. Changes in trade policies and tariffs can affect material and equipment costs.

risks.title: Driver shortage
risks.score_rationale: Driver shortage is a major industry challenge that can increase wages and costs without proportional improvements in freight rates, directly impacting operational profitability.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive trucking sector, which limits growth opportunities and profitability in case of pricing pressure.

risks.title: Technology dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company heavily relies on information systems for operations, fleet management systems and logistics services, creating risks in case of technology failures or cyberattacks.

risks.title: International operations risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's operations in Canada and Mexico (cross-border services) are exposed to currency fluctuations, trade policy changes, and political instability.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks due to its dependence on IT systems for transportation operations and management of sensitive customer data.

risks.title: Loss of key personnel
risks.score_rationale: Loss of key management or operational expertise could affect company performance, although operations are largely operationalized.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has no significant mentions regarding artificial intelligence in the provided 10-K excerpts.
